channel.title: Central African Republic - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Central African Republic, every source cited.

item.title: Central African rebel leader gets 15-year sentence in Chad
item.description: The FDPC movement rejects the verdict and demands the release of General Abdoulaye Miskine, detained since November 2019.

item.title: CAR opposition leader criticizes foreign troops in election
item.description: Anicet-Georges Dologuélé says Russian Wagner and Rwandan forces secured the December 28, 2025 presidential vote.

item.title: Kaga-Bandoro residents struggle with economic hardship
item.description: Low incomes and few opportunities make daily survival a challenge for people in Nana-Gribizi.

item.title: Central African Republic activist questions floods' spiritual meaning
item.description: Sosthène Dingombé asks if deadly Bangui floods carry a message beyond natural disaster.
